description.value: The study investigated structural cerebral correlates of trait impulsiveness and perceptual reasoning in 115 healthy 14-year-olds using optimized voxel-based morphometry and whole-brain voxelwise multiple regression, followed by correlations of identified frontal clusters with WISC IV performance.

spans.text: This study focuses on the common structural underpinnings of both trait impulsiveness and related cognitive functions using optimized voxel-based morphometry (VBM) in a large sample of adolescents.

description.value: Observational, cross-sectional study of healthy adolescents recruited from secondary schools; written informed consent was obtained from adolescents and legal guardians. No intervention or blinding was reported.

description.value: Optimized voxel-based morphometry preprocessing of structural MRI images using SPM8, including visual quality control, segmentation, extraction, normalization to MNI space, modulation, and smoothing.

spans.text: The image processing followed the optimized VBM protocol [Good et al.,2001] implemented in Statistical Parametric Mapping (SPM) 8 (Wellcome Department of Neuroimaging, London, United Kingdom; http://www.fil.ion.ucl.ac.uk/spm) running on Matlab R2007a (MathWorks, Natick, MA).
